balls.text: Zaheer has finished off in style here! Praveen lost the plot somewhat, length ball again, and what's more, sliding down the leg. Zaheer picked it up, and hoicked it over short fine-legs head, a couple of bounces to the boundary.
slower ball this time, and Zaheer is ready for the length but not for the lack of pace, mis-times it to long on and Malinga scampers back for two.
Zaheer has climbed into that one! Praveen knows how to use the bouncer, but can't bowl a yorker to save his life, and Zaheer is taking full advantage. Flat bats it over long off, really huge six.
short of a length, Zaheer spots it early and swats it powerfully down the line to long off. Mid off is in and once it got past him, that was four.

got him! Short ball from Praveen, well directed again. Harbhajan top-edges the pull really high. Kallis gets under it and takes it easily at square leg. Bangalore have perfected the art of using bouncers to good effect in Twenty20.
full again on off, driven hard down to extra cover by Zaheer, who scampers back for two.
very well played! Zaheer was expecting a full ball, it was outside off, he stayed back, opened the blade and guided it nicely behind point
short ball and Harbhajan was late into the pull. Fended away in the end to midwicket.
full and wide outside off, just inside the tramlines, Bhajji can't get bat on it.
full on middle and leg, Zaheer stays back and swats it the way only a tail-ender can, to long on
slower ball outside off, Zaheer stays back and guides it to point.
drilled off the front foot, off the pads, towards square leg

what a catch! Dravid, take a bow! Short and hurries on to Satish, he's late on the pull, and the ball balloons towards midwicket, Dravid has room to cover, gets there and puts out a right hand and tumbles, and comes up with the ball. Top catch!
excellent save by Praveen at third man, outside off cut away fiercely by Harbhajan, and the shot nearly yorks Praveen at third man, he stays back and saves it.
front-foot forehand from Harbhajan Federer, but can't get it past Steyn
similar ball, smilar shot from Satish, but it goes finer, on the bounce to third man

and he's holed out to deep cover! That was not part of the plan for Pollard - full outside off at 139.9kph from Steyn, Pollard looks to carve it over the off side, but the timing's not good enough for six, and too good for him to not be caught. Kohli takes an easy one at sweeper.
worked away from the pads to square leg for a single. Fifteen of the over, Mumbai will be pleased.
good bouncer, catches Pollard by surprise as he looks to get forward, gets the top-edge and goes where only top-edged pulls and Dilscoops go - behind the keeper's head
full on leg stump, driven powerfully along the carpet to long on
slower ball, back of the hand, and Satish plays it with the turn, so to speak, towards Kohli at point. Good hand from Satish here.
shorter this time, stays back and gets a leg bye to the on side
Pollard finally shows why he commanded that obscene price at the auction! Picks up the length ball from Praveen and redirects it into orbit. It eventually lands in the crowds over long on. Top shot!

wrists the length ball from leg stump, towards midwicket for a single. End of a masterly spell from Kumble. Sometimes, you feel it's unfair that a bowler is allowed only four overs in this format. I'd pay money to see Jumbo bowl a couple more.
short of a length, leggie on leg stump, Pollard plays him away quietly
sliding down this time, picks a leg bye to square leg
squeezes it down nicely through the really small gap at point. Poor fielding from Steyn inside the circle and it runs away.
shortens the length and cramps him for room, goes for the cut and might have got a feather on that, but the loud appeal was turned down by umpire Dharmasena
full on leg and middle, gets forward and smothers the spin.
lunges out this time, but Kallis follows him and fires it on his pads. Gets it on to the off side, towards cover
short ball, he was waiting for it this time. Swats it from outside off, towards midwicket.
expertly done! Stays back and guides the fast short ball, down to third man for four.
short of a length, angling in, Pollard stays back and works it to midwicket
slower ball, 112.6 kph, outside off. Satish opens the face and runs it down well to third man. Not enough pace on that ball to go to the boundary.
full on middle and leg, Satish stays back and flicks it with soft hands. They run through for two.
short and fast outside off, Pollard lets it go. He can't get himself out here, he's crucial to the cause.
straighter this time, and he connects with the pull. Not much timing in it though.
and again, 137 kph outside the off stump, and Satish tries a very ambitious pull, sends thin air to the boundary, but misses the ball.
beaten for pace outside the off stump.
sensational fielding by Manish Pandey at point! It was timed quite well, but he dived to his right and nearly created a run out opportunity
Full and fast on off stump, defended back safely
misfield, first in the game, from Anil Kumble at square leg, lets them run through for two
nice shot! Satish frees his arms and makes use of the few inches of room he had outside off, and sends it through to the point boundary
back of the hand slower ball this time, at 98.9 kph. On leg and middle, Pollard waits and plays it to midwicket
short of a length, outside off, gets forward and tips and runs. Really soft hands there.
stays back and guides this one down, behind point
Vinay has his tail up and is making the ball talk here. Really well directed bouncer, Pollard weaves away as if he were avoiding Mohammad Ali's jab

slider on offstump, and Pollard gets a thick outside edge that runs down towards the third man fence. Praveen tags it ruthlessly, dives headlong and pulls it in. Top notch effort that, and it's only fair that the last ball of that great over did not go for four.
shortens the length and slips in the googly, Pollard defends off the front foot
full on off stump, gets forward and drives to short cover
Flippa! On offstump, Pollard stays back and keeps it out.
full on off stump, with a forward short leg crouching, Pollard blocks off front foot.
full on middle and off, gets forward and drives to long on
Bravo is gone now! Vinay has picked three wickets in an over and ripped open Mumbai! Good ball, angling in again, short of a length, pegs Bravo back and catches him plumb in front of middle and leg.
sliding down leg again, gets it down to Boucher for a quick single
Satish walks out, and goes for a pull shot first ball, is late on the shot and can't make contact.

The big Big fish is gone! Straight ball, angling from middle to leg, and Sachin tries to get inside the line and work it down. He exposes leg stump, the ball finds a way past and disturbs the woodwork. Mumbai Indians are in big trouble now.
short and angling into Bravo, he rises up and taps it down to the leg side.
Rayudu goes! Mumbai have a bit of a wobble. Short and outside off, Rayudu tries a half-hearted half-cut, half-guide down to third man and gets a thick edge through to Boucher.
length ball on off stump, tapped away off the front foot to point and that's well run
stays back and punches down the ground to long on for one.
another beautiful googly! Shortens the length, increases the pace and pegs Rayudu well back, but it probably did a little too much, and hence Rayudu survives the big lbw appeal

Jumbo has not lost one bit of the zip! Wonderful, wonderful googly, draws Tiwary down, and then turns from leg, beats the attempted loft by inches and crashes into the stumps. Great bit of bowling, and it's quit amazing to see that Kumble has not lost a single trick, despite being out of cricket for quite a while now.
short of a length, Sachin dances down and goes inside out, but can't quit get under it. A couple of bounces to deep cover.
full on leg stump, worked away off the front foot towards midwicket
very good slower ball outside off and beats Sachin all ends up. Hits the outside edge as he swings hard, and dribbles through to Boucher.
more conventional this time, looks to drive the full ball down the ground. Half stop by Vinay
full outside off, Tiwary stays back and sledge-hammers it down to long off, Pandey puts in a dive and nearly stops it, but its through for four. Dhoni would have been proud of that shot!
short and well outside off, but Sachin walks across and pulls it to square leg.
slow ball, back of the hand, Sachin tries to guide it past point, but can't beat Kohli. Tiwary is backing up a long way, but gets back.
slow ball angling across at 119 kph, driven through the covers off the front foot
googly again, but not full enough, Tiwary spots it and hits powerfully to long off
very straight, on middle, Sachin makes room and looks to whack it through the covers
sweeps, but can't beat short fine leg
oh, close call there! Full and straight, beat the attempted sweep and thudded into his back thigh, but Dharmasena ruled in favour of the batsman
fuller on middle stump, Tiwary gets forward and smothers the googly.
length ball outside leg, Tiwary flicks to mid off and Sachin hares through for two.
makes room to a good short ball, and guides it down to deep point for a single. Tiwary sees the ball early and packs a punch. Really good prospect.
Whack! Picks the short length soon and lines it up well, really big swing of the bat sends it over mid off, couple of bounces and four!
front foot pull to the short ball, down to mid off. Tough to visualise, but that's what Tiwary did.
good slower ball, nicely driven off the front foot and some good fielding at cover ensures there's no run scored
marginally straighter this time, and Sachin picks him off middle and sends it to square leg.
again on Sachin's pads! He has them in some kind of a trance here! Change of pace, but does not bother the Master one bit, he tucks it away to fine leg.
looks to force the ball through the off side this time, but can't find the gap
aggression from Tiwary! Walks down the track and lets out a monster pull that turned him all the way around and sent the ball to midwicket in a trice. Powerfully hit!
they continue to feed Sachin on his pads, but this time he is unable to time the flick to the boundary
tries to bounce him again, and Tiwary pulls it, but controls it and sends it along the carpet to deep midwicket
short of a length, outside off, played away to the off side
good bouncer again, and Tiwary has little control over the pull, but it falls in an empty space.
fuller this time, Tiwary gets forward and defends to mid off, and they take off for a really tight single. The under-arm misses the stumps, and Tiwary must be relieved.
short of a length again, on middle and leg, Tiwary plays it to the off side, for no run
short of a length on off stump, defended off the back foot

Kallis has his man! The good old strategy of bouncing out young Indian batsmen pays off again. Kallis lets rip a very accurate bouncer, Tare is late into the shot and it pops up straight to short midwicket.
Tare tears into this one! Short and wide outside off and Tare swats it like a fly off the back foot. Runs away for four at great speed.
on the leg stump, but it's Tare this time, not Sachin and hence it does not go to the boundary. Instead goes straight to short midwicket

and again! At 127 kph, Sachin will send these to the boundary all day. It's even further outside leg this time and the master has no problems. Three fours to square leg, and Steyn is having nighmares of Gwalior!
shortens the length, but same line and it makes no difference to Sachin! Stays back, rises on his toes and flicks it in the same direction!
and he pulls out that flick again! Minimalist effort, a turn of the wrists with that heavy bat, sends the ball scurrying to square leg for four.
similar ball, similar shot, but this time they set off quickly for a single.
slips down the leg again. Easy take for Boucher, but Steyn has to rebowl that one.
similar ball, nice shot with straight bat and high elbow, but not straight enough to elude mid on
short of a length, outside off. Played safely off the back foot.
misses the pull on a short and straight ball, but Sachin calls Tare through for a quick single.
short of a length outside off, played off the back foot to mid off and Sachin's off. Collides into Praveen at the non-striker's end. Ouch.
vents his anger out on this short and wide one outside off, but hits it straight to Kohli at point
sliding down the leg and swinging down, all the way for four. Wrongly called leg byes and Sachin's not pleased
slower ball, leg cutter on middle and leg, Sachin works it towards midwicket
and he pulls out the back-foot cover drive this time, but can't get past mid off
starts wide and then swings away a mile. Sachin's standing well out to counter the swing, and lunges but still can't reach it.
squeezes it through the slips. Late on the shot and hence got a thick outside edge, it did not carry to Kallis and ran away
play and a miss! Really quick for Tare this.
great take by Boucher behind the stumps, or in front of the goal if you like. That was very wide down the leg side. Jumps to the left and collects it well.
fast and furious outside off, he lets it go.

and he's nailed him this time! Similar ball, on a length from over the wicket and straightening after pitching on middle, catches Sanath on the hop. Umpire Kumar Dharmasena thinks for a moment and sends his long-time team-mate back. Big wicket!
gets it right this time and swings it into Sanath at good pace. He gets forward and drives straight to mid off
working up some pace, up from 133 to 140 ks, but this one slides down the leg side
good length on off stump, Sanath shoulders arms, that's a rarity
short of a length outside off, Sachin looks to punch it off the back foot and can't pass short cover
and the other way this time, but Sachin spots it early and wrists it away to the sweeper on the on side. He's made this shot a specialty in recent times.
big swing away from Sachin and really late too. Misses the outside edge and Boucher has to dive to collect it.
short again, on middle stump and swinging away towards the slips. Sanath taps to the off side and runs
short of a length outside off, Sachin comes down the track and tucks it to short midwicket for a quick one
nice swing from leg to off, and Sanath thick-edges to third man. Praveen's been swinging it consistently so far.
low dipping full toss and Kallis plays a delightful straight drive past the non-striker. A little pump of fist from him. Bangalore have won by 7 wickets. Kallis will remain not out yet again.
drags the short-of-length delivery to deep square-leg region for couple of runs. The scores are level.
leans forward to push the full-length delivery to right of mid-off
slower, fuller, around off stump line, squeezed out to backward point
That should settle it. Pollard banged it short and Kallis nearly pulled it to Bravo at deep midwicket boundary. Bravo ran in and threw in a dive but couldn't reach. Pollart holds his head in agony.
short in length and just outside off, run down to third man
banged in short around off stump line, pulled away to deep midwicket
on the pads, clipped wide of fine-leg fielder for couple of runs
length delivery on the middle and off, steered to backward point
slowish bouncer around off, Kallis swats it past square-leg
slow length delivery around off stump line, pushed through point
flicks the full delivery past square-leg
goes for the slow yorker, short of the blockhole, stabbed to the off side

Virat is run out .. Slightly slower, short in length, Kohli is early through his pull shot and the ball bounds off the body to the off side ... Pollard swoops in from backward point and fires a direct hit at the non-striker's end with Kohli just outside the crease .. Virat lost a valuable second as he turned to look back at the fielder to see which side he was going to throw. mistake.
low full toss, Kallis calmly taps it to long-off
from round the stumps, full and outside off, sliced away uppishly to third man
hurls across a bouncer and Kohli withdraws his pull shot and gets out of the way
short in length, moving across Kohli who guides to backward point
stays on the back foot to clip it to left of Malinga at deep backward square-leg
gets forward to ease it down to long-on
very full again, on driven to long-on
pushed through full and quick, pushed out to the on side
Whack! he opened up his stance this time to crash the short-of-length delivery just over wide long-on boundary.
Flighted across full and Kohli just reached out to lift it with the turn over long-on. He made that look very easy. He didn't charge out and neither did he look to hit it too hard.
around the off stump line, tapped to the on side

super yorker, just outside off stump, Kallis tries to get the bat down in a hurry but the ball squeezes through below the bat and some how misses the off stump. Zaheer appeals  .. for lbw? for catch? but not sure whether it hit anything - bat or pad - en route to the keeper
full in length, moving away from Kohli who runs it down to third man
full in length angling across Kohli who steers to backward point. Zaheer stares hard at Kohli who walks away to square-leg

Caught at deep backward square-leg boundary and Zaheer gives a mouthful to Robin as he walks off. Hmmm... It was the short delivery at the body and Robin pulls and pulls well but can't beat Malinga in the deep.
leans forward to drive to sweeper cover
full and angling away from Kallis who allows it to pass him
banged in short, Robin flat-bats it wide of long-on for couple of runs
high bouncer outside off and Kallis fetches it from outside off and plays a controlled pull past square-leg. Seventh IPL fifty. He is yet to be dismissed this tournament
outside off stump, dabbed past backward point
works this one through midwicket for a single

the very slow bouncer outside off and Kallis thinks about pull, thinks about puling out of it, thinks about chopping it to the off side - he had so much time- and in the end the ball lobs past the bat!
slower one around the off stump line, turned to midwicket
around the off stump line, pushed out to point region
works this one to the on side

OMG! Robin Uthappa has killed this full-length delivery.  It has sailed over the ground! What a stunning hit. Robin shuffled slightly to the off side and thwacked the full delivery high over wide long-on. The white ball flew right over the stadium, high over the concrete roof. What a big hit. What violence!
walks towards off and runs this down to third man
full delivery on the off and middle line, Robin lifts it over the infield but makes contact with the inner half of the bat and the ball rolls down to deep midwicket
a bouncer outside off and Robin gets down under
goes down on his knee to sweep it really hard but there is a fielder at deep midwicket who mops up
And plays the reverse sweep again, this time to third-man region. He swept it from around leg stump and it bounces past the leaping Bravo, who had moved to his right from slip
Aaha! the reverse sweep is out now. It was delivered from round  the stumps and Robin leaned forward to reverse sweep it to backward point boundary
stays back to clip the off break on middle and leg past square-leg . One slip in place
fuller, gets forward to push it to midwicket
shuffles to the off stump line and stabs a topspinner to the off side
full delivery, on the middle, eased through the on side
backs away to force it to the off side
He is up and running now with a fierce slog sweep. He went down on his knee to slog-sweep it to midwicket boundary
leans forward to drive to cover
dropped by Tare It was a wide delivery outside off and Robin gets a bottom edge on the cut and Tare can't hold on to the tough chance
stays back to punch it to long-off
from round the stumps, a lovely topspinner that goes past the outside edge. Lots of over spin on that and it bounces just past the defensive prod
and now Harbhajan screams after taking out Pandey. Pandey swiped that straight to Pollard at midwicket.
Manish is all smiles after lifting it over long-on. He lunged forward to smoke it really high and it sailed just over the boundary, past the leaping Tiwary
stays back to work the ball from off stump to backward square-leg
leans forward to push it to the on side
gets forward to push it to Harbhajan who seems to have caught the fielding virus going around .. fails to stop the ball
stays back to punch the ball on leg and middle line to long-on
around off stump line, steered to point region
backs away to drive to long-off
Whack! It was a short delivery and Manish opens his stance to pull it really flat , one bounce to the wide midwicket boundary
on the middle and leg line, Kallis stays adjacent to the line, opens his bat-face and steers the ball to point
around off stump, Manish stays back to play the flat-batted thump to long-off.
on the middle stump line, worked to square-leg
shuffles to the off and leans forward to flick the flighted off break from off stump line to deep midwicket
stays back to tap the off break to the on side
quicker, shorter in length, turning in from outside off, swatted past square-leg
flighted across, slower than the previous delivery, eased to midwicket
turns in to the middle stump line, clipped to deep backward square-leg
full and hint of inward movement, driven to cover where Tendulkar makes a mess of a regulation stop. Bravo, wisely!, doesn't react angrily this time
gets outside off and cuts to backward point
outside off stump, mistimes the cut to point
More free gifts. This time from Bravo. Full pitched and outside-leg, please help yourself delivery, and Kallis laps it around the corner to fine-leg boundary
gets forward to defend to the on side

Another fine late-cut. Kallis played it really late but what a mess-up from Malinga near the boundary. He ran to his left and tried to stop it with his left foot but the ball went past him. Bravo isn't pleased and gives him the T cup pose.
back of length outside off stump, Manish punches it to extra cover .. Tiwary makes a half-stop
length delivery outside off stump, eased back to the bowler
moves forward to work it to the on side

Three in a row though this was the least impressive of the three shots. IT was a full delivery on the middle stump line, Kallis went for the straight drive but got a lucky fat inside edge to long-leg boundary

Fabuliciously deft late cut. It was bowled from wide of the crease and it straightened outside off stump, Kallis waited on the back foot, opened the bat-face to steer it very late to third-man boundary
Slap! It was the short-of-length delivery outside off stump and Kallis slaps it to the point boundary
low full-toss, whipped to right of long-on where Harbhajan makes a diving stop
whips this one to deep square-leg where Tiwary makes a diving stop
Deliciously yummy! It was the full delivery on the middle and Manish leans forward, front leg in the air and bottom-hands it right over long-on.
leans forward to ping long-on
around off stump, keeper is standing up, steered to backward point ... the fielder fires in a direct hit but Kallis is home
gets behind the line to tuck the length delivery to square-leg

The two West Indians in the mumbai line-up didn't sparkle today but Kallis plays a Calypso-style pull. He lifted his front leg in the air and pulled the ball from outside off over square-leg. Stylish.
Glassily gorgeous. Full pitched around off stump and Kallis caresses it straight past the bowler.
high bouncer which should have been called a wide but the ump doesn't, Hmmm
pushed to point to Pollard and then the drama begins. Pollard threatens to throw at the non-striker's end, Manish stops short of his crease and asks him to throw!
Slam! The in-form Kallis backs away to punch a short-of-length delivery over the bowler's head. He had actually mis-hit it, making contact at the bottom of the bat but such is his form
stays back to defend to the off side

Again that flat-bat forehand through mid-on. It wasn't all that short but he pulls of the flat-batted almost pull shot and this time between the bowler and mid-on. PReviously he had gone to right of mid-on and the fielder was pushed slightly to the right.
walks down the track and shuffles towards the off stump in the process and tries to clip a length delivery to the on side. He misses and is hit on the pad. It pitched outside leg stump
back of length on the leg stump line, swatted away to the on side. Again he was moving around in the crease.
Manish plays a fine cut to left of backward point but Pollard intercepts with a lunging dive
backs away to jab a length delivery to the off side
Forehand cross court. It was a short of length delivery around off stump, Manish flat-bats it to right of mid-on.
leans forward to flick the overpitched delivery but can't get it past Dhawan standing left of square-leg. he should have put that one away
length delivery around off stump line, Kallis tries to punch it on the up and doesn't time it well - it was in the air briefly but fell well short of the bowler
loverly slower one, fullish, Manish just about manages to pick it in time and checks his drives and smothers it towards on side where Dhawan stops
full pitched on middle and leg, flicked to square-leg where Babu (Shikhar Dhawan, the sub) stops

dropped by Rayudu who has hurt himself in the process. It was the slower one on the middle and leg,  Kallis decides rather late to play the uppish flick and Rayudu lunged out to his left to try take the over-head catch but couldn't hold on. Worse ...he landed on his elbow. Ouch.
slings it across on a full length on the middle and leg and gets it to shape in towards middle, Kallis holds his balance to push it back down the track
on leg stump this time, turned away fown to deep square leg for one
good lines to the right-handers, angling in from middle and leg, steered away off the back foot behind point
full again, homing in on middle and off, Kallis gets forward and drives towards sweeper cover
full outside off, and late swing that beat the 'keeper by more than it beat Pandey. They run through for a bye.
full on off stump, Pandey gets half forward and drives towards cover.
full and wide of off stump, 131.5 kph, Pandey lets it go.
